An unconfirmed enemy may be disengaged only after every old target is more than 48 blocks away horizontally; record disengagement rather than claiming a kill. Nearby threats still require the existing kill-or-stop behavior.
verification: Unit tests and build verification are required; multiplayer hot-reload and renewed supply operation remain separate live checks.
